data.tip1: here must be the controller that fires the `D [Execute] E`;if not,then lock the controller again
data.tip2: for a step [of] `D [Execute] A`,whether it has extra conditions,it should not lead the whole execution to fail when firing it
data.tip3: it(the step) should lead the whole execution to fail(after firing it) when the step failed to run successfully
